formal_statement: ∀ E : List (Fin 6 × Fin 6), E = [(0, 1), (0, 2), (1, 2), (0, 3), (1, 4), (2, 5)] → ∀ τ : Fin 6 × Fin 6 → Finset (Fin 6) → Fin 6, (∀ e ∈ E, ∀ I : Finset (Fin 6), (∀ f ∈ E, ¬ (f.1 ∈ I ∧ f.2 ∈ I)) → (τ e I = e.1 ∨ τ e I = e.2) ∧ τ e I ∉ I) → ∀ c : Fin 6 × Fin 6 → ℚ, (∀ I : Finset (Fin 6), (∀ f ∈ E, ¬ (f.1 ∈ I ∧ f.2 ∈ I)) → ∀ v : Fin 6, ((E.filter (fun e => τ e I = v)).map c).sum = 0) → ∀ e ∈ E, c e = 0
plain_statement: On the net with edges 01, 02, 12, 03, 14, 25 (a triangle with a pendant edge at each vertex): let a typing assign to each edge e and each independent set I (the empty set included) an end of e outside I, and orient e towards it. Every rational weighting of the edges for which, for every independent set I, every vertex has weighted in-degree 0 in the orientation of I, is zero on every edge.
title: On the net, for every typing, an edge weighting with zero weighted in-degree in every admissible orientation is zero
